title: OBS for church and faith livestreams
why: Livestreams reach the sick, the travelling and the curious. A reliable stream is now part of serving a community.
what_is_different: Faith livestreams run every week with volunteers: they need simple scenes, clear audio from the sound desk, lyrics and scripture overlays, and a checklist anyone can follow.

extra_modules.title: Volunteer-proof setup
extra_modules.outcome: You can: make the stream easy for any volunteer

starter_project: Build a weekly livestream setup: three scenes (pre-service, main, scripture/lyrics), audio from the desk, a checklist and a backup plan.
pitfalls: One person who knows how everything works

expert_validation.note: AI-drafted outline; to be validated by a practitioner and an educator in this field.
